title: One aging clock: policy-pass alerts follow the board's stage SLA, once per stint
deviations_from_card: (1) Write set grew by ONE file: app/features/shared/pipelineTypes.ts. ROLE_SLA_DEFAULTS / STAGE_SLA_DEFAULTS / STALE_DAYS / slaForStage MOVED into app/_lib/aging-policy.ts and are re-exported from pipelineTypes.ts (all importers keep their path). Importing slaForStage from pipelineTypes instead would have put that client module (and lucide-react) on db/pipeline.ts's graph, i.e. on ~40 API routes (+2 modules each, measured). (2) Also touched shared surface perf-budget.json under the lock: aging-policy.ts is +1 module / ~12 KB on every route that imports db/pipeline.ts; raised the app/api/**/route.ts group 225/3000 -> 226/3012, eight route overrides +1/+12 KB, app/page.tsx +1/+6 KB, each with a why. (3) The TS->Python bridge is a drift test, not codegen: pipeline/jobfit/tests/test_automation.py AgingTierSyncTest reads aging-policy.ts's AGING_TIERS and AGING_TIER_ALERT literals and pipeline-stages.ts STAGE_ROLE's terminal names and asserts equality with automation.AGING_TIERS / AGING_TIER_ALERTS / TERMINAL_STAGES (the test_fit_threshold_sync.py shape). Python receives the tier string per entry; no SLA number crosses. (4) Per critic floor note, both catalog namespaces reworded (pipeline.events AND analytics.log.kinds). (5) The case-5 test lives in the existing app/_lib/db/pipeline-automation-input.test.ts (the colocated test of listActiveEntriesForAutomation). (6) Beyond the card: an aging alert on an applied ADVANCE (or a staleSkip) is dropped, because a row written after the move would land inside the NEW stint and suppress that stint's first alert under the stage_changed_at key; pinned by a test.
notes: tsc exit 2 ONLY on the untracked foreign kpi-sim/runs/** tree (no error on any tracked path). test:perf red only on app/page.tsx 1385/1380 modules and 8816/8779 KB (my share, +1 module/~6 KB, already raised; the other +5 modules/~37 KB are sibling in-flight work) and the known job-ingest.ts. Full test:unit 9678/9678 green. pipelineRenderDiet.test.ts failed once (1 of 12) then passed on 3 reruns: a time-boundary flake, not this change (agingBucket parity is pinned separately). Commit order: catalog, docs and perf-budget commits (lock-held, committed alone) landed before the test/feat pair. Integration note for card B (next wave): automation-pass.ts now routes both loops' alerts through the exported recordDecisionAlerts(d, entrySnap, summary, dryRun); an 'approved' selection that marks a decision skipped should still call it (alerts stay autonomous). AutomationEntry now requires agingTier.
